keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Athletic Club 0, Espanyol 0.

Substitution, Athletic Club. Beñat Gerenabarrena replaces Beñat Prados.

Iñigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Athletic Club) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
